{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research Intensity", "construction": "R&D expense divided by total assets, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that invest more in research and development are more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to long-term growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Percentage of total sales attributed to the top 5 customers, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with a diverse customer base are less exposed to customer-specific risks, leading to more stable returns. This measure captures a firm's customer concentration risk.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability", "construction": "Environmental liability reserves divided by total assets, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities are more likely to experience future regulatory and reputational risks, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's exposure to environmental risks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Turnover", "construction": "Annual employee turnover rate, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high employee turnover rates may experience lower productivity and higher recruitment costs, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's human capital management.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "Number of unique suppliers divided by total cost of goods sold, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains are more exposed to supply chain disruptions and risks, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's supply chain management.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Diversity", "construction": "Percentage of female and minority directors on the board, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with diverse boards may experience better decision-making and risk management, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to diversity and inclusion.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tax Aggressiveness", "construction": "Effective tax rate divided by statutory tax rate, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that engage in tax aggressive strategies may experience future tax risks and penalties, leading to lower returns. This measure captures a firm's tax management practices.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Lifecycle Stage", "construction": "Average age of products in the firm's portfolio, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with products in the growth stage of the lifecycle may experience higher returns due to increasing demand and market share. This measure captures a firm's product development and innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Diversification", "construction": "Percentage of total sales attributed to foreign markets, measured over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with diverse geographic revenues may experience lower exposure to country-specific risks, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's international diversification.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Investment in Information Technology", "construction": "IT expense divided by total assets, measured over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms that invest more in information technology may experience higher returns due to increased efficiency and competitiveness. This measure captures a firm's commitment to technological innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
